subject: uruk-accounts
shortOutcome: Separate a visible mark from an inferred purpose.
deeperOutcome: Compare how records and buildings reveal cooperation while leaving people out.
facilitatorRubric: Describe one mark without translating it; identify one thing an account leaves out.
steps: Find one round impression and one incised mark in the tablet photograph. Describe their shapes without translating them.
Imagine recording a shared meal. Choose a category to track and an amount; use words or your own marks on paper.

steps: Find the wreck location and recovered materials in the solid part of the diagram. Name two things found together.

subject: byzantium

steps: Find an opening through the carved frame, a figure projecting from the background and a line of letters in the supplied photograph. Describe each before naming its meaning.

subject: haitian-revolution
